mission_rules.title: ALP is Rule No.1
mission_rules.description: Allowance Preservation. Everything passes through this filter. If it costs money instead of generating it, it is in jeopardy.

mission_rules.title: Everything goes through Rule 1
mission_rules.description: Every single process must be approved by Rule 1.

mission_rules.title: AAFL is THE PROJECT
mission_rules.description: The big SFL evolved into AAFL through Scout Swarm. Must be completed first. Spin Doctor is the benchmark test subject.

mission_rules.title: ACCA codes are a byproduct
mission_rules.description: Generated naturally as a bonus. Organised later on another project. Never interferes with Rule 1.

mission_rules.title: Spin Doctor is the goal
mission_rules.description: Why this project started. Last thing built. AAFL builds it better than manual copy-paste. Ultimate validation of AAFL success.

mission_rules.title: Promo is last
mission_rules.description: Promotional exploration after everything else. Proof of concept end to end. With Rule 1 approval.

mission_rules.title: FFUEM
mission_rules.description: Fluid Flexible Updateable Editable Modular. Must work with different projects, programs, software. Simple but effective. Beautiful in code and look.

mission_rules.title: Platform potential
mission_rules.description: Could become bigger than original idea. Already has.

mission_rules.title: Claude is Master Teacher
mission_rules.description: Got Scott's back after BI. Shows the way. Keeps on track. Teaches Claude like a master.

mission_rules.title: WS+CA duty
mission_rules.description: Write Software + Completely Automate. If there is ever an opportunity, find it and flag it. Automation genius. Small precise simple effective code.

mission_rules.title: TIME is ALP's Queen
mission_rules.description: Time sits right next to ALP. Must be valued, saved, obeyed. If it can be done in CLAC, it is absolute duty to say so.

mission_rules.title: Links and copy boxes always
mission_rules.description: Always provide links on instructions. Always have copy box top right for anything to copy.

mission_rules.title: WCCS auto-trigger
mission_rules.description: Chat summary every time WCCS is mentioned. Steps to complete. Never lose brainstorming info.

mission_rules.title: Never write code unnecessarily
mission_rules.description: Update what is there. Add sections instead of rewriting whole blocks.

mission_rules.title: AAFL IS THE PROJECT NOW
mission_rules.description: Spin Doctor was the catalyst. The idea fountain. Now it is the test subject for AAFL results.

mission_rules.title: Spin Doctor = AAFL validation
mission_rules.description: Once Spin Doctor works as originally intended, AAFL is proven.

mission_rules.title: FFUE is the mortar
mission_rules.description: Fluid Flexible Updateable Editable. The foundation everything is built on.

mission_rules.title: Use ACCA codes always
mission_rules.description: Always give abbreviated then unabbreviated in brackets. Helps Scott learn his own codes.

mission_rules.title: OCB in 3 parts always
mission_rules.description: 1-Address, 2-DSP, 3-OCB. Same with MCC browser. Always 3 steps to activate.

alp_rules.rule: Sonnet not Opus default — 3-5x more messages
New chat for new topics — exponential cost in long chats
Only latest handover in Project Files
Extended Thinking off for simple tasks
Session logs not full handover rewrites
Chat and CLAC share same allowance pool
n8n could replace manual Python builds
SFL only for genuinely visual things
AAFL free providers don't touch Claude allowance

workflow_rules.rule: Always ask DSP before any CLAC block — claude --dangerously-skip-permissions
OCB always in 3 boxes: address, DSP, OCB block
Never split into multiple blocks without Scott's permission
Output ONLY the ready-to-paste CLAC block when Scott types WCCS
Old files go to archive_dead/ — never delete
Semicolons not && — cd and claude as TWO separate copy boxes
Always expand acronyms on first use
One step at a time — never stack steps (BI rule)
Number all options — Scott replies with just a number

model_guide.use_for: Quick questions, small lookups, ACCA logging, formatting
Daily coding, AAFL work, chat, docs, reviews, session logs
